question: Which Bharatanatyam dancer became the second youngest dancer to be honoured with the 'Padma Shri' award in 1991?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alarmel Valli**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Bharatanatyam dancer** who became the **second youngest dancer** to be **honoured with the 'Padma Shri award in 1991 is Alarmel Valli.**
 
• She was born on** September 14, 1957, in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.**
 
• She is one of the most famous** Bharatanatyam dancers** in India and has** been awarded several prestigious awards for her contributions to the art form.**
 
• In addition to the **Padma Shri,** she has also been **awarded **the **Padma Bhushan and the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.**

 [IMAGE: https://www.webindia123.com/dances/dancer/alarmel1.jpg] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hema Malini **is an Indian film actress, producer, and **Bharatanatyam dancer **who has appeared in numerous Bollywood films.

 
 
• She is also a trained classical dancer and has performed in several dance dramas.
 
 
 
• **Narthaki Nataraj **is a transgender Bharatanatyam dancer from Tamil Nadu, India.
 
 
• She is the **first transgender person to be awarded the prestigious Padma Shri award **for her contributions to the field of dance.
 
 
 
• **Saroj Khan **was an Indian dance choreographer in the Hindi film industry.
 
 
• She was known for her **iconic choreography in Bollywood films and won several awards for her work.**
 
• **She passed away on July 3, 2020.**
